title: Recurring memory growth, restarted before
query: Payments is eating more and more RAM as the day goes on. We bounced it last week and it went back to normal for a while, and now it's creeping up again. Should I be worried?
root_cause: Payments keeps an in-memory cache that grows with every request and is never freed.

remediation.detail: Restart payments to reclaim memory, then bound the cache.

evidence: Memory for payments has grown steadily and is near or above the alert threshold
Payments WARNING receipt cache size entries are present
An earlier restart only reset memory temporarily
